name: Banseiki Sengoku trees: first research and civic progress

steps.code: local limit=GameConfiguration.GetValue('GAME_TURN_LIMIT'); if limit~=DB.MakeHash('TURNLIMIT_NONE') then error('turn limit not NONE: '..tostring(limit)) end; return 'turn limit NONE after Create Game setup'

for _,victory in ipairs({'VICTORY_DEFAULT','VICTORY_CONQUEST','VICTORY_TECHNOLOGY','VICTORY_CULTURE','VICTORY_RELIGIOUS','VICTORY_DIPLOMATIC','VICTORY_SCORE'}) do if Game.IsVictoryEnabled(victory) then error('official victory enabled: '..victory) end end; local endTurn=Game.GetGameEndTurn(); if endTurn>0 then error('hard turn limit: game ends at turn '..tostring(endTurn)) end; return 'no official victory or time limit enabled'

if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset') end; local t,c=0,0; for row in GameInfo.Technologies() do t=t+1; if not string.find(row.TechnologyType,'TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official tech: '..row.TechnologyType) end end; for row in GameInfo.Civics() do c=c+1; if not string.find(row.CivicType,'CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official civic: '..row.CivicType) end end; if t~=32 or c~=30 then error('wrong tree counts '..t..'/'..c) end; if GameInfo.Eras['ERA_ANCIENT'].Name~='LOC_JAC_SENGOKU_ERA_1_NAME' then error('Sengoku era missing') end; if not GameClimate or not GameClimate.GetTemperatureChange or not Game.GetWorldCongress then error('GS core APIs missing') end; if GameClimate.GetTemperatureChange()==nil or not Game.GetWorldCongress() then error('GS systems inactive') end; return '32 techs, 30 civics, GS systems present'

local n=0; for id,_ in pairs(g_kItemDefaults) do n=n+1; if not string.find(id,'TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official tech in UI: '..id) end end; if n~=32 then error('tech UI count '..n) end; return 'TechTree shows only 32 Sengoku nodes'

local n=0; for id,_ in pairs(g_kItemDefaults) do n=n+1; if not string.find(id,'CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official civic in UI: '..id) end end; if n~=30 then error('civic UI count '..n) end; return 'CivicsTree shows only 30 Sengoku nodes'

local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; if p:GetCities():GetCount()~=0 then error('expected settler start') end; local s=nil; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetType()==GameInfo.Units['UNIT_SETTLER'].Index then s=u; break end end; if not s then error('missing PoC settler') end; UnitManager.RequestOperation(s,UnitOperationTypes.FOUND_CITY); return 'capital requested'

local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; local t='TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_IRRIGATION_WORKS'; local c='CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_HOUSE_RULES'; local tr=p:GetTechs():GetResearchPath(GameInfo.Types[t].Hash); local cr=p:GetCulture():GetCivicPath(GameInfo.Types[c].Hash); if not tr or not cr then error('first-node paths unavailable') end; UI.RequestPlayerOperation(Game.GetLocalPlayer(),PlayerOperations.RESEARCH,{[PlayerOperations.PARAM_TECH_TYPE]=tr,[PlayerOperations.PARAM_INSERT_MODE]=PlayerOperations.VALUE_EXCLUSIVE}); UI.RequestPlayerOperation(Game.GetLocalPlayer(),PlayerOperations.PROGRESS_CIVIC,{[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CIVIC_TYPE]=cr,[PlayerOperations.PARAM_INSERT_MODE]=PlayerOperations.VALUE_EXCLUSIVE}); return 'first Sengoku tech and civic selected'

local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; local science,culture=0,0; for _,id in ipairs({'TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_IRRIGATION_WORKS','TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_COASTAL_PILOTAGE','TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_IRON_FORGING','TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_EARTHWORK_FORTS'}) do local amount=p:GetTechs():GetResearchProgress(GameInfo.Technologies[id].Index); if amount>science then science=amount end end; for _,id in ipairs({'CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_HOUSE_RULES','CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_KOKUJIN_LEAGUES','CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_TEMPLES_AND_BELIEVERS'}) do local amount=p:GetCulture():GetCulturalProgress(GameInfo.Civics[id].Index); if amount>culture then culture=amount end end; if science<=0 or culture<=0 then error('first research did not progress '..tostring(science)..'/'..tostring(culture)) end; return 'root research progress science='..science..' culture='..culture
